our_interpretation: The claim concerns the February 2023 Bing chatbot release. The target period is that launch month, with the assessment limited to the decision and conduct described by the February 26 post.

The ordinary factual reading is that Microsoft released the chatbot despite known problems without honoring relevant safety commitments. A failure occurring after release does not, by itself, establish disregard of those commitments.
Published safety requirements can make the allegation checkable, but Marcus does not identify a particular requirement or an acceptable level of residual risk.
The word 'likely' qualifies prior knowledge; it does not assert certain knowledge of every reported incident.
